facts.text: Rod is a referral from Phil Velayo.

USP: compassionate firm, perfect 34-year record, 99% retention, deep relationships.
Domains on Ionos: magnumwealthmanagement.com, beyondexitplanning.com.

LPL compliance: disclaimers on all pages, no performance claims.
Hard rules: no promissory language, no investment guarantees.
Magnum pages: Home, About/Team, Services, Resources (Snappy Kraken), Contact with LPL footer. Beyond Exit pages: Home, Process, Case Studies, Contact.
Demo Jan 20, launch post-approval. Target Jan 20/25.
Phase 1 design & branding, target Jan 15.
